title: RWB-S6-E5026-APP: the data-room slice has no plan row for its three consumed contracts, its partner channel or the lot status of the opening
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.3 and R9; WP B2-S6-003 story line RWB-S6-E5026-APP (H, C, I, X); context pack S6 rwb-debtsale (service row, ownership rows, Architecture v5 slides 3, 4, 5, 8 and 13, Temporal and Drools slides 5, 12 and 13); legacy RWB-E5-026; FSD S6 Debt sale v3 A1.2, A1.4, A2.3, A2.4 and Requirements served; TSD S6 Debt sale v2 T2, T3.0 to T3.3, T4, T5.1 to T5.3, T6.1, T6.2 and T-A; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-DBS-03 and FEAT-DBS-04; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DS-10, R-DS-11, R-DS-12 and R-DS-13
section: Metadata (Depends on (build), Contract dependencies, External dependencies); Sections 2, 3, 4, 8, 9, 11, 12.2, 12.3, 12.4, 12.9, 13, 15, 18 and 19
description: (1) The plan gives H = RWB-S6-E5026-CON, RWB-PLT-E1027-CON and RWB-PLT-N001-CON with C, I and X empty, while the step reads the masked tape of rwb-document, the admitted buyer panel of rwb-partner and the case state of rwb-case and answers the case move to rwb-case, so four consumed rows have no plan row. (2) The read is reached by a buyer through the partner gateway in the DMZ under a FAPI 2.0 profile, and that channel has no plan row and no pattern row of its own; DP-19 covers the staff route of the gateway-bff composite only. (3) R-DS-13 opens the room to buyers who have signed the non-disclosure agreement, but no source gives the panel operation, the panel status values or the agreement field of rwb-partner, so the row carries the placeholder. (4) The tape and its masking-check result are the deliverable of RWB-S6-E5025-APP and a document of rwb-document, and no source publishes the tape read or the masking-check outcome field. (5) TSD S6 T3.2 gives LOV-LOT-STATUS as BUILDING, OFFERED, AWARDED, TRANSFERRED and CLOSED, none of which names a data-room opening, so the lot status the opening would carry is unnamed; the data room itself has no table although the service owns it. (6) The TSD requirement table maps REQ-S6-003 to FEAT-DBS-01 while the FSD gives the room to FEAT-DBS-04, and the split plan carries no requirement id for this slice. (7) The service owns topic rwb.debtsale.events.v1 with event EV-23 and DP-09 is absent from the pattern set of this key, while this step publishes nothing. (8) The legacy permission row of the key gives the Partner portal right R to a holder list that differs from the role matrix of TSD S6 T6.1.
evidence: WP B2-S6-003 story line RWB-S6-E5026-APP with three H rows and empty C, I and X; Template and Rules v1 R5.5 rows DP-03, DP-13 and DP-19; context pack ownership rows (debt_sale_lot and debt_sale_account, 5 REST operations, event EV-23, workflow DebtSaleWorkflow, no jobs); FSD S6 A2.4.2 (integration point Partner portal) and A2.4.3.1 (VR-S6-004-1, BR-S6-004); TSD S6 T3.2 LOV-LOT-STATUS and LOV-PUTBACK, T5.1 INT-25, T5.3 (LotAwarded published only), T6.1, T-A.1 API-S6-004 and T-A.2 error lists; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DS-10 to R-DS-13; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 FEAT-DBS-03 and FEAT-DBS-04; legacy RWB-E5-026 Data, Endpoints, Screen and states, Permission checks and Guardrails
area: Dependency, ownership, channel and requirement trace
proposed: Keep the plan H, C, I and X rows exactly as they stand; record the rwb-document, rwb-partner and rwb-case rows as class C dependencies in fact, with their placeholders and their fakes; record the partner channel as an edge dependency with no plan row; reference the tape and never build it; write no lot status of the opening; adopt REQ-S6-003 and FEAT-DBS-04 for traceability; record the outbox library as the absent row of the topic that the award and transfer stories need

title: RWB-S6-E5026-CON: the consumed operation names, the tape element, the panel fields, the lot status and the event set of the data room have no published baseline
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.2 and R9; WP B2-S6-003 story line RWB-S6-E5026-CON; context pack S6 rwb-debtsale; legacy RWB-E5-026; FSD S6 Debt sale v3 A2.4 and Requirements served; TSD S6 Debt sale v2 T3.1 to T3.3, T4, T5.1, T5.3, T6.1 and T-A.1 and T-A.2; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-DBS-04; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DS-10 to R-DS-13
section: Metadata (Depends on (build), Contract dependencies); Sections 2, 7, 8, 11, 12.1, 12.2, 12.3, 12.4, 12.8, 12.9 and 15
description: (1) TSD S6 T-A.1 gives API-S6-004 as GET partner/data-room/{lotId} under the monolith base, and the target base /api/recovery/debtsale/v1 is a DP-13 move, so the path is derived and not copied. (2) No source publishes an operation for the tape read of rwb-document, for the buyer-panel read of rwb-partner or for the case-move answer of rwb-case; TSD S6 T5.2 names the module interfaces and no operation. (3) TSD S6 T3.3 gives the relationships of the two lot tables but publishes no DataRoom element, so the element names, the tape element and the required flags are fixed by this baseline. (4) TSD S6 T3.1 gives borrower_code but no masking form, and no field of the tape is in the S6 field list; the tape is a P5 document. (5) TSD S6 T-A.2 gives the error set as status codes with no message id per condition, so each condition is bound to a message of the legacy and FSD set. (6) TSD S6 T5.3 names LotAwarded as published and no AccountsTransferred row, while the architecture gives both, so both are named and declared as the award and transfer stories'. (7) LOV-LOT-STATUS carries no data-room value, so no lot status is declared for the opening. (8) The plan's C, I and X rows of this slice are empty while the contract declares three consumed rows and one partner channel.
evidence: TSD S6 T-A.1 operations API-S6-001 to API-S6-005 with the monolith base form and T-A.2 error lists 401, 403, 404, 409, 422 and 503 without message ids; TSD S6 T3.1 field list, T3.2 lists and T3.3 relationships; TSD S6 T5.1 INT-25, T5.2 and T5.3; context pack ownership rows and connection-matrix row S6; FSD S6 A2.4.3.1 VR-S6-004-1 and BR-S6-004 and Requirements served REQ-S6-003; legacy RWB-E5-026 acceptance criteria, Data, Endpoints, Screen and states and Permission checks; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DS-10 to R-DS-13
proposed: Publish the baseline with the placeholders, declare the DataRoom, lot, account and tape elements with their required flags, bind every error condition to one message id of section 14, declare the case boundary as the child workflow input, signals and stage outcome, record the buyer channel as an edge dependency, declare no event and no lot status of the opening, and confirm the three operation names with their owners before the tag
